Calibration diagnostics report (PDF)

Source: R/plot_model_calibration_report.R
plot_model_calibration_report.Rd

Pages:

  1. Simulations and ensemble ESS. The simulation-convergence status (green / yellow / red, from status) with its four checks, reasons and flags; tables for all draws (the posterior) and for the best-fit ensemble; the posterior ESS against the draws (log-log) stacked on the best log-likelihood found so far, on a shared x axis.

  2. Parameters. Monte Carlo error of each posterior mean (left) and prior-to-posterior KL divergence (right). Above 60 parameters the location-specific parameters are grouped by base name (point = worst or median location, bar = range over locations).

  3. Fit. The fit table (and the worst-fitting locations of a multi-location run) over weekly time series of observed and predicted counts on the scored weeks.

  4. Predicted vs observed. Weekly log-log scatter over the square-root-scale distributions of weekly counts, cases and deaths.

  5. Appendix. What each metric means, generated from the glossary.

Every threshold drawn comes from status$checks[]$threshold_green / threshold_yellow; the status, labels, reasons and flags are shown exactly as written by calc_convergence_status. A panel whose inputs are missing (deaths not scored, a path with no points, an empty fit block) is replaced by a note rather than failing the report.

Usage

plot_model_calibration_report(
  diagnostics,
  dir_output = NULL,
  file = "calibration_report.pdf",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

diagnostics

Path to calibration_diagnostics.json, or the list it parses to. Must carry schema_version "2".

dir_output

Directory the PDF is written to (created if needed). Default NULL: the directory holding diagnostics when it is a path.

file

File name of the PDF. Default "calibration_report.pdf".

verbose

Logical; report the written path. Default TRUE.

Value

The path of the PDF, invisibly.

Details

Renders the MOSAIC calibration-diagnostics report from 3_results/calibration_diagnostics.json (summary.json schema 2 companion). The report answers the three calibration questions, each on its own page, and reads nothing but that file and the metric glossary (inst/extdata/metric_glossary.yml): no samples, predictions or configs are opened, so it can be re-rendered from a finished run.

The PDF is vector (base pdf() device, 11 x 8.5 in) and is written to a temporary file then renamed, so an interrupted render never leaves a truncated report. A run made before MOSAIC 1.4.0 has no calibration_diagnostics.json; its figures carry the notice from .mosaic_calibration_report_legacy_notice() in place of a status.

See also

calc_convergence_status

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_model_calibration_report(
  file.path(dir_output, "3_results", "calibration_diagnostics.json"),
  dir_output = file.path(dir_output, "3_results", "figures"))
} # }
